title: Fixed Cutaway Tank and Paired Spiral Reel
description: One newly authored complete dry film-developing-tank-style cutaway set, counted as one prop. A thick cylindrical tank wall has one deliberate fixed front quarter cutaway over a complete closed floor. Inside, a real through-bored central tube and three bottom spokes support two separate complete continuous flat spiral guide ribbons at different heights; three whole upright separators connect corresponding spiral stations. The spiral intervals are empty, with no film or liquid. A complete matching profiled lid lies inverted separately on its integral flat crown so its open stepped inner locating recess is visible. No old suspended perforated basket, audio reel deck, winding mass or dye-vat parts imported. New internal paired continuous spiral organization and cutaway tank, not a plain bucket given a different label. Four opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up, complete set horizontal bounds centred and two whole ground soles. Fixed illustrative exterior/cutaway only: no chemical process, photographic development, light seal, capacity, fluid retention, loading, rotation, manufacture, compatibility or safety capability verified. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
